Satellite name ANDESITE Sensor Node
Form factor Picosatellite
Units or mass 0.38 kg
Organization Boston University
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Small satellite with various sensors for distributed measurements deployed from ANDESITE.
Description

One of 8 small picosatellites to be deployed from ANDESITE. Contains magnetometer, radios, GPS, EPS and science payload.
